answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 1362 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Please, tell me about pant or Paijama length is it permissable upto down feet but maximum people only prayer time make it up we should do it same or we have to reduce our cloth length upto (Takhna)? Question: Please, tell me about pant or Paijama length is it permissable upto down feet but maximum people only prayer time make it up we should do it same or we have to reduce our cloth length upto (Takhna)? Answer ID: 1362 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 855/855=J) It is haram whether in salah or in normal condition to wear the pants, trousers etc below ankles. There have been narrated a couple of severe punishments for the same. However, wearing pants etc below ankles in salah is worse and it makes salah makrooh-e-tahreemi (undesirable to haram extent). Therefore, you should wear it above ankles so that you are sinful neither in salah nor out of salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
